cands.name: Ryan Gill
cands.bio: Sixth-generation Floridian and cattle rancher from the Fort Lonesome/east Hillsborough area; 2022 Farm Credit Agriculturalist of the Year; former chairman of the Hillsborough Soil and Water Conservation District. Republican; no GOP primary opponent.
cands.local_ties: Born and raised in east Hillsborough; family has farmed the same land 120+ years (his site; Florida Politics). HD 68 includes Plant City.

record.text: Elected to the Hillsborough County Soil and Water Conservation District (chair for two years); serves on the Plant City Chamber, Hillsborough Cattlemen's Association and other boards (his campaign site).

money_notes.text: Had raised nearly $124,000 across his campaign and political committee Conservatives for Florida Agriculture as of the mid-2026 report.

endorsements.text: Associated Industries of Florida, Lt. Gov. Jay Collins, Sen. Danny Burgess, Rep. Lawrence McClure, Sheriff Chad Chronister, Florida PBA, Americans for Prosperity Action.
